qualification_policy: Observed failures remain failures. Passing mechanics, source checks or isolated dependencies do not substitute for the stated outcome gates. No postqualification retuning is relabeled as preregistered evidence.

items.goal: Do not count one physical event as independent evidence; distinguish target prior from observation likelihood.
items.observed: Capture-level identities, separate target-prior API, disjoint WAV pairs and constrained maximum-entropy comparisons are implemented and independently replayed. Improved conditional NLL did not improve posterior decisions on the held-out rank-view task.
items.next_required: Develop joint evidence using historical fit/validation only; freeze posterior decision and calibration gates before a new source-disjoint evaluation.

items.goal: Forecast the actual deployed policy with identical admission, refusal, owner, costs and continuation.
items.observed: All admission decisions, cold restores and delivered files replayed exactly. The frozen fresh qualification had 3 wrong commitments among 424 ID episodes: 0.00707547 versus a 0.004999 cap. Marginal ECE and declared OOD gates passed; those do not establish tail adequacy.
items.next_required: Calibrate semantic tail loss and the multiplicative risk critic on new development data, then run one preregistered qualification on unspent sources. Do not retune on the three qualification errors.

items.goal: Actions have genuinely different external losses, costs and tail outcomes.
items.observed: Real delivered answers and abstentions have different payoffs. Changing risk preference changes 654 decisions, reduces errors and increases abstention; higher risk-sensitive certainty equivalent trades against lower mean reward.
items.boundary: This is an identified finite output task, not a proof of global multimodal portfolio optimality.

items.goal: Delivered numeric feedback changes neuron state, a later controllable action, and actual external payoff.
items.observed: The numeric-feedback arm improves final preference match by 10.9375 percentage points against the zero-feedback arm in 128 paired cases. State, cold restore, later action, media and costs are replayed.
items.boundary: Simple history and a small linear memory have identical actions and delivered bytes under matched kernel charges. Corruption RNG indices match development; this is not fresh-noise generalization or exclusive neuron superiority.

items.goal: Matched-information and matched-compute generator updates yield repeatable real-output gains while retaining base capability.
items.observed: Three fixed seeds and two objectives used 1843200 actual training deliveries plus a separately accounted pilot. Risk-versus-original certainty-equivalent difference is -0.004180056; its 97.5% paired interval crosses zero. Base-retention noninferiority also failed. One seed selected the original-policy fallback before qualification.
items.next_required: Change the training model or objective using development data, preserve the full prior negative run, and freeze a new fixed-budget grid and new qualification before evaluation. Do not continue selecting seeds until a positive result appears.

items.goal: Extend beyond digits to natural speech, video and document tasks with measured quality and actual cost.
items.observed: Frozen video interpolation preserves the declared quality margin while reducing CPU time. Speech gate timing was corrected and re-executed with byte-identical transcripts; a cheaper fixed greedy baseline also passes quality noninferiority. The independent document replication has positive quality gain but no demonstrated speedup.
items.next_required: Integrate these natural paths into a single actual Hepta controller and compare against the strongest fixed policies with full encoder, control, delivery and continuation costs. Natural speech generation, open video generation and a jointly trained all-modality foundation model remain untested.

items.goal: Close observed dependency and build failures without weakening policy or dropping features.
items.observed: The unchanged cargo-deny scan fell from 22 to 15 errors after coherent Cargo/Bazel TLS updates. ZIP v2 passed core-plugins 426/426, i18n-config 3/3 and secrets 9/9. Unchanged protocol source/assertions with regenerated fixtures passed all 303 regression tests, and all three generated files are published. The nextest report/profile/store repair passed 20 targeted tests and real nextest 0.9.103 microprobes before publication. The unified port producer at exact head 1e4f8b5c failed Cargo resolution: Matrix store-encryption 0.19.1 requires blake3 ^1.8.7 while Starlark 0.14.2 pins =1.8.2; downstream qualifications therefore remain pending.
items.next_required: Prepare and verify a narrowly scoped Starlark compatibility port, rerun the coherent candidate, full upstream AWS coverage, actual old Matrix migration, unchanged dependency policy, scoped Bazel and normal platform gates before activation. Complete the independent native ARM64 Linux Synapse qualification without changing the original Mac contract.

items.goal: Retain all qualification outputs, failures, independent audits and executed source in retrievable artifacts.
items.observed: Five scientific archives totaling 510605199 bytes, a 45021371-byte CI checkpoint and a 9690743-byte runtime increment were saved successfully after actual restoration checks. Both the failed native restore and corrected path-isolated restore remain retained. The runtime increment retains the complete 88bcc7f logs including three old protocol failures and a real timeout, the independent 303/303 protocol success, and the nextest collector bugfix source/probes. New unified port run 40497632113 requires a subsequent evidence increment.
